name: TriumphSubstation2
title: Triumph Substations (2.1 port)
author: Azmandios
description:
Adds three new advanced substations to the game.
- Longer wire reach
- Bigger supply area
- More expensive
- Adds the Electric Energy Distribution 3 research
* Advanced Substation
* Experimental Nucleonic Substation (volatile)
* Reckless Substation

Community update of the original "Triump Substations" mod by Logvinov Alecksey (Factorio 1.1) for Factorio 2.1. The original idea and assets belong to the original author (MIT license).
Original mod: https://mods.factorio.com/mod/TriumphSubstation
Sources: https://github.com/Azmandios/factorio-triumph-substation

There is a separate mod name (TriumphSubstation2) because the original name is taken on the Mod Portal. The internal prototype names are unchanged, so the port can be used with saves and blueprints from the original mod.

The Experimental Nucleonic Substation can be used with roboports.

Uses quantum, temporal and rubber band science to allow electricity to flow to such a large area. The rubber bands keep the wire tight.

USE AT YOUR OWN RISK!
